**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no employee non-solicitation or no-hire covenant. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ", and "personnel" surface only the independent-contractor language in Section 10.2 ("neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative") and confidentiality references to employees. The restrictive covenants that do exist (Company at p0037, HDI at p0042) are exclusivity covenants about participating in similar Internet projects — business-scope restrictions, not personnel solicitation — and are properly addressed under a different rule.

Since our client, The Deerskin Companies, is under no non-solicit or no-hire obligation, the document sits at the **preferred** position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), not merely the fallback.
